nodes.label: Memory Ownership
nodes.rationale: Allocated pointers need explicit ownership and a release path; moved reallocations require rebuilding interior pointers from offsets.

nodes.label: Instruction Encoding
nodes.rationale: ROM images use a fixed eight-byte, little-endian encoding rather than the native Instruction representation.

nodes.label: C11 Portability
nodes.rationale: Persistent and public binary formats must not depend on host layout, endianness, or padding.

nodes.label: Focused Testing
nodes.rationale: Changes require focused tests, integration coverage for the assembly-to-execution path, and Debug and Release builds.
